fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that provide good road speed and adequate armor protection for the infantry squad carried inside. Wheeled transport is cheaper to maintain than tracked or hover alternatives, making these formations a cost-effective choice for garrison duty on developed worlds with solid road infrastructure. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
